I enjoyed a full day of eating in Selangor, far away from any kind of tourist areas, so just authentic local Malaysian food.

I started today's adventure in the Setia Alam area of Shah Alam, where I'm currently staying.

One of the most popular Malaysian breakfasts in Nasi Lemak, but I'd already tried that in a previous video in Kuala Lumpur, so I decided to give the other popular Malaysian breakfast meals a try, the Roti Canai.

It's a type of fried Indian flatbread that you dip into a hot curry and munch, but I got the special 'Banjir' version. Banjir means flooded, and this style involves the chef chopping up the roti for you and then drowning it in the dal and curry mixtures for you to eat with a spoon.
